project_info.theme: Toyota Hilux off-road test-drive obstacle experience
project_info.color_palette: Grass green, black, red, white, sky blue

main_subject.detail: A live event photo showing a black Toyota Hilux climbing down a dirt mound on an outdoor obstacle course. Toyota branding appears top left and on tall event flags. The pickup is centered, angled slightly toward the camera, with a visible license plate and the front axle articulated over uneven dirt. The background contains orange cones, red inflatable Toyota arch structures, Toyota feather flags, trees, grass, and other Hilux event vehicles parked behind. Bottom-right script says 'Move your world'.
main_subject.style: Real event-documentary automotive photo emphasizing off-road capability and practical terrain articulation

items: Top Left: Toyota logo over a green park-like event setting
Top Right: Tall Toyota feather flag and apartment blocks behind trees
Bottom Left: Orange cones and grassy edge of the obstacle course
Bottom Right: Handwritten 'Move your world' over the grass
Center/Background: Black Toyota Hilux driving over a dirt mound within a branded off-road demo course framed by arches, cones, and support vehicles

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Documentary daylight, realistic dirt texture, crisp vehicle reflections, action-demo authenticity

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Toyota Hilux off-road demo experience. Centerpiece is a black Toyota Hilux descending a dirt mound on a branded outdoor obstacle course. Background is a grassy event field with Toyota flags, an inflatable Toyota arch, cones, trees, and parked support vehicles. Surrounding elements: Toyota logo and the footer script 'Move your world'. Technical style: photoreal event action photography, natural outdoor event lighting, realistic dirt texture and crisp reflections, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
